answer: Deposits are visible in opal, and umber reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 70 aliases, and each one needs its own funded oasis account. A farm of 2516 identities would post 1904 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
